commands.review_summary:
The branch adds an `isTransientCompactionError` skip path for timeout/provider 4xx/5xx preflight compaction failures and includes a separate session reset lifecycle label-preservation change.

PR surface: Source +37. Total +37 across 2 files.

Reproducibility: yes. at source level: current main classifies timeout/provider failures but the preflight skip set excludes them, then `runPreflightCompactionIfNeeded` throws before the agent run starts. I did not run a live Control UI reproduction in this read-only review.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] The PR needs contributor or maintainer follow-up because the retryability finding remains, the branch has mixed scope, and ClawSweeper should not fabricate the missing real behavior proof for an external contributor.

target.title: fix(reply): degrade gracefully when preflight compaction fails instead of throwing
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When preflight compaction LLM call fails (timeout, rate limit, or provider error), the entire reply operation terminates and the Composer is permanently locked in "terminated" state.

## Why This Change Was Made

The code comment at agent-runner-memory.ts:206 already states: "Preflight compaction is a guardrail, not a hard dependency". But when compaction failed, it threw `Error(...)` irrespective of the failure type.

Fix: degrade gracefully for **transient errors** (timeout, provider 5xx/4xx) but keep non-retryable errors (auth, guard, summary, unknown) terminal. Added `isTransientCompactionError` helper.

## Changes

- `src/auto-reply/reply/agent-runner-memory.ts`: Add `isTransientCompactionError` helper; degrade gracefully for transient errors only (+37/-12)

## Real behavior proof

**Behavior addressed:** Transient preflight compaction failures no longer lock the Composer.
**Environment tested:** Node 22.x on Linux
**Steps run after the patch:** Called production classifyCompactionReason function to verify transient vs terminal classification.
**Evidence after fix:**

```text
=== Transient errors (degrade gracefully) ===
  timed out                  -> timeout        -> DEGRADE
  timeout                    -> timeout        -> DEGRADE
  500 Internal Server Error  -> 5xx            -> DEGRADE
  502 Bad Gateway            -> 5xx            -> DEGRADE
  503 Service Unavailable    -> 5xx            -> DEGRADE
  429 Rate Limited           -> 4xx            -> DEGRADE
  400 Bad Request            -> 4xx            -> DEGRADE

=== Non-retryable errors (remain terminal) ===
  guard_thread_binding       -> guard_blocked  -> TERMINAL
  summary_failed             -> summary_failed -> TERMINAL
  auth_profile_mismatch      -> unknown        -> TERMINAL
  something went wrong       -> unknown        -> TERMINAL
```

**Observed result:** Transient errors (timeout, 5xx, 4xx) are correctly classified and degraded gracefully. Non-retryable errors (guard, summary, unknown) remain terminal.
**Not tested:** Live session with triggered preflight compaction failure.

Fixes #100778
